[LCRS.7.4] If no timeout rule exists and the adapter never responds,
the correlation leaks in the sense that the call's side
effects (the cooldown window) persist normally, but no rule fires
because nothing matches. Adapters should publish
service-level deadlines (e.g., HA-bridge fails calls not
answered by HA in 10_s and emits `CallError`) so rules that
forget timeout matchers at least get a `CallError`.
